character: Belle Époque spa town at the foot of Mont Blanc. Home to the Mont Blanc Tramway — the highest rack railway in France (to Nid d'Aigle, 2,372m). Thermal baths with naturally warm mineral water (200+ years of tradition). Gateway to Evasion Mont-Blanc ski area (325km linked with Megeve).
description: Saint-Gervais-les-Bains is a Belle Époque spa town at the foot of Mont Blanc, combining thermal bathing, skiing on the Evasion Mont-Blanc domain (linked to Megeve, Combloux, La Giettaz), and high-mountain access. The Mont Blanc Tramway (rack railway built 1913) climbs from Le Fayet station to Nid d'Aigle at 2,372m — the highest railway in France and the starting point for the normal route up Mont Blanc via the Goûter. The Bains du Mont Blanc thermal spa (renovated, open year-round) offers indoor and outdoor pools with naturally warm mineral water, saunas, steam baths, sensory spaces, and a wellness trail — all in a Belle Époque park at the foot of the Bonnant gorges. The Valléen gondola connects Le Fayet station to Saint-Gervais village in 6 minutes. The ski area at Bettex (1,400-2,350m) is part of the 325km Evasion Mont-Blanc. Saint-Gervais Distillery produces Mont Blanc Gin with gin-making workshops (Gin School, €95/person). A quieter, more relaxed base than Chamonix, 1h05 from Geneva.

stats.rack_railway: Mont Blanc Tramway to Nid d'Aigle (2,372m)
stats.thermal_baths: Bains du Mont Blanc — 200+ year tradition

villages.name: Saint-Gervais Village
villages.character: Perched village with shops, restaurants, traditional architecture. Access via Valléen gondola from Le Fayet (6 min).

villages.name: Le Fayet
villages.character: Valley floor — TGV station, thermal baths district, Belle Époque architecture. Mont Blanc Tramway departure.

villages.name: Le Bettex
villages.character: Ski area base station — direct access to Evasion Mont-Blanc pistes (325km). Ski-in/ski-out accommodation.

non_ski_activities.thermal_baths: Bains du Mont Blanc — naturally warm mineral thermal water (200+ years of tradition). Indoor and outdoor pools, saunas at different temperatures, steam baths, sensory spaces, wellness trail, tisanerie. In a Belle Époque park at the foot of the Bonnant gorges. Holistic approach combining visual, auditory and sensorial experiences.
non_ski_activities.mont_blanc_tramway: Highest rack railway in France (built 1913). From Le Fayet to Nid d'Aigle (2,372m) — 1hr journey. Starting point for Mont Blanc ascent (Goûter route) and high-mountain hikes. Stops at Bellevue, Mont Lachat, and Nid d'Aigle. Summer and winter operation.
non_ski_activities.distillery: Distillerie de Saint-Gervais — Mont Blanc Gin. Visit and tasting €5/person (free with purchase). Gin School workshop €95/person — select botanicals, distil your own gin, take home your creation. Ages 18+. Book 48h ahead.
non_ski_activities.swimming: Municipal pool — 25m lane pool with submerged speakers, 17x10m outdoor pool with slide, 43m² children's play area with water games, paddling pool. Relaxation area.
non_ski_activities.ice_skating: Ice rink in Saint-Gervais (skate rental included)
non_ski_activities.leisure_pass: PASS LOISIRS — unlimited access to Evasion Mont-Blanc lifts, Valléen gondola, pool, ice rink, mini-golf, library, Maison Forte de Hautetour, Museum of Sacred Art, La Cure cultural centre.
non_ski_activities.climbing: Le Topo climbing hall (year-round, routes, boulders, children's area, homemade food). Outdoor climbing in the Thermal Park. Mont Blanc Parc Aventure — tree-top adventure courses for ages 3+ including Bambins, 4 difficulty levels, zip line courses.
non_ski_activities.other: Paragliding (Flying Light annual event), canyoning, rafting, via ferrata, mountain biking (bike park, pumptrack, skate park), mini-golf, trail running, hiking, 4 museums, baroque church at Saint-Nicolas-de-Véroce, guided heritage tours

honest_drawbacks: Lower altitude village (850m) — snow variable at valley level
Requires Valléen gondola to reach main ski area at Bettex
Spreads across multiple villages — car/shuttle sometimes needed
